games.mechanicDescription: A timing game: a bright marker sweeps across a horizontal track and the player taps only while it overlaps a clearly bounded golden success zone.
games.focus: Steppling beside the track at the exact moment the marker enters the success zone

games.mechanicDescription: A one-minute live step challenge: a large circular countdown and a rising step-progress meter respond to the player's real movement.
games.focus: Steppling moving beside the countdown and a visibly filling step meter

games.mechanicDescription: A live step target challenge: the player walks until a prominent step counter reaches its goal before the round timer ends.
games.focus: Steppling racing an hourglass while the step meter approaches its finish marker

games.mechanicDescription: A paced breathing game: one large central orb slowly expands for the inhale, pauses, then contracts for the exhale.
games.focus: Bedrotte calmly following the single expanding moonlit breath orb

games.mechanicDescription: A 6-by-6 merge board: the player drags identical ingredient tiles together to evolve them into larger dishes, then serves two visible customer orders.
games.focus: Feastle pointing to two matching ingredient tiles combining on the board, with two small order plates nearby

games.mechanicDescription: A sorting game: individual food, drink and tableware tokens are dragged into three clearly distinct labelled-by-icon table zones.
games.focus: Feastle placing one food token into the correct of three table zones

games.mechanicDescription: A concentration card game: face-down cards form an orderly grid and the player turns over two at a time to find matching illustrated foods.
games.focus: Feastle revealing two identical food cards while the remaining cards stay face down

games.mechanicDescription: A sliding block puzzle: several different-sized coloured rectangular task blocks crowd a square desk grid; the player slides them without overlap and guides each block out through the matching coloured doorway on the board edge.
games.focus: Tasklet studying the crowded grid while one rectangular block lines up with its same-colour edge exit

games.mechanicDescription: A task-triage sorting game: one task card at a time is dragged into one of three action columns according to what it needs next.
games.focus: Tasklet moving a task card toward the correct of three distinct desk columns

games.mechanicDescription: A word-path puzzle: a compact grid of letter tiles is connected by one continuous adjacent path to spell the target word.
games.focus: Pagelet tracing one luminous continuous path through adjacent abstract letter tiles

games.mechanicDescription: A five-letter deduction game: each submitted five-tile guess receives green, amber or dark feedback showing correct, misplaced and absent letters across up to six rows.
games.focus: Pagelet beside a six-row, five-column guess board with a clear mix of green, amber and dark blank glyph tiles

games.mechanicDescription: A five-question book trivia round: one illustrated question card appears above four large answer-choice cards.
games.focus: Pagelet considering four distinct answer cards beneath an open magical book

games.mechanicDescription: A concentration card game: face-down garden cards form a grid and the player turns over two cards at a time to uncover matching plants.
games.focus: Mossprout discovering two identical plant cards among orderly face-down garden cards

games.mechanicDescription: A sequence-memory game: several coffee ritual pads light one after another and the player taps the same pads back in order.
games.focus: Baristabbit watching three coffee-symbol pads illuminate in a clear sequence

games.mechanicDescription: A sorting game: practical-task tokens such as a form, parcel and household item are dragged into distinct action bins.
games.focus: Errandimp placing one practical token into the correct of three action bins

games.mechanicDescription: A sequence-memory game: sunrise lantern pads glow one by one and the player repeats the exact order.
games.focus: Dawnle watching a row of sunrise lantern pads illuminate in sequence

games.mechanicDescription: A paced breathing game: one central soft orb expands, holds and contracts to guide a short sequence of slow breaths.
games.focus: Mendle following the gentle contracting breath orb in a quiet uncluttered scene

games.mechanicDescription: A sequence-memory game: a small set of calm symbol pads lights in order, then the player taps the same sequence back.
games.focus: Quietome observing four restrained symbol pads with one visibly glowing

games.mechanicDescription: A five-question film trivia round: one cinema-themed question card appears above four large answer-choice cards.
games.focus: Flickerbun choosing among four answer cards inside a warm projector beam

games.mechanicDescription: A concentration card game: face-down gallery cards form a grid and the player turns over two at a time to reunite matching artefacts.
games.focus: Relicoon uncovering two identical museum artefact cards while other cards remain face down

games.mechanicDescription: A rhythm recall game: four large coloured beat pads present a short musical phrase and the player taps that rhythm back on the same pads.
games.focus: Encora tapping one of four clearly separated rhythm pads as a beat trail sweeps across them

games.mechanicDescription: A sequence-memory game: several social lantern pads glow one after another and the player repeats their order.
games.focus: Gatherglow watching four warm lantern pads illuminate in a readable sequence

games.mechanicDescription: A block-blast puzzle: an 8-by-8 square-cell board sits above a tray of three different polyomino pieces; the player drags a whole piece onto empty cells and a completely filled row or column flashes and clears.
games.focus: Cheerlet beside the full 8-by-8 board while an L-shaped three-cell piece is dragged from the three-piece tray to complete a glowing row

games.mechanicDescription: A five-question city trivia round: one city-scene question card appears above four large answer-choice cards, with five stops shown as progress.
games.focus: Skylo choosing among four answer cards beside a five-stop miniature city route

games.mechanicDescription: A sequence-memory game: moon and star signal pads light in order, then the player taps the same pattern back.
games.focus: Vesperitt studying four moonlit signal pads arranged beneath a simple constellation
